verdict.rationale: The docs clearly support a project-local install: the installer writes editable skill files into your repo as ordinary files you own (docs-2, docs-24, docs-47). There is also a second route, a managed read-only plugin bundle installed via `claude plugins install` (docs-1, docs-10, docs-41). However, that route is framed as subscribe-vs-fork, not as a user-global scope that applies across all projects. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a user-global install scope, an explicit choice between project and user scope, and confirmation that project-local files are meant to be committed with the repo.
